What’s the difference between Hyaluronic Acid and Sodium Hyaluronate?

•⁠  ⁠Hyaluronic Acid is the original molecule that helps retain moisture, but because of its larger molecular size, it mainly hydrates the surface of the skin.

•⁠  ⁠Sodium Hyaluronate is the salt form of hyaluronic acid. It has a much smaller molecular size, allowing it to penetrate deeper into the skin for longer-lasting hydration and better moisture retention.
